item.title: Nikola Jokić (DEN): Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cameron Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokić will start Monday’s game against the Rockets.
item.description:
Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cameron Johnson, Aaron Gordon and Nikola Jokić will start Monday’s game against the Rockets.

All five Nuggets’ starters were upgraded from questionable to probable on Monday afternoon, and they’re now available. The Nuggets will roll out their usual starting five against the Rockets.

Raphielle Johnson

Fonte: Denver Nuggets

item.title: [Injury] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić (elbow) and Aaron Gordon (lower body) are probable for Monday’s matchup with the Rockets.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić (elbow) and Aaron Gordon (lower body) are probable for Monday’s matchup with the Rockets.

Joker and the rest of the starting five were initially listed as questionable to face Houston, but the group plus DeMar DeRozan are all expected to take the court. Fantasy managers should keep an eye on the injury report ahead of tip-off for final availability confirmation.

Zak Hanshew

Fonte: NBA Injury Report

item.title: [Injury] Nikola Jokić (DEN): Nikola Jokić (elbow) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Rockets.
item.description:
Nikola Jokić (elbow) is questionable for Monday’s game against the Rockets.

Jokić is dealing with a sprained right elbow, but he hasn’t missed a game this season. If he can’t play on Monday, the Nuggets will likely turn to Marvin Bagley III to fill the void.

Raphielle Johnson

Fonte: NBA Injury Report
